message.reasoning_content:
The compiler error indicates that `ST_Pump` is an unknown type. The interface definition says:

```
| Input/Output | `pumpGroup` | `ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump` | Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd. |
```

And the ST_Pump type definition is:

```
| `priority` | `INT` | Priority; larger values have higher priority. Read-only to the function block. |
| `selection` | `BOOL` | Manual-selection state. Read-only to the function block. |
| `RunComd` | `BOOL` | Run command written by the function block; TRUE runs and FALSE stops. |
```

So I need to define the ST_Pump type before the function block. Let me create a proper TYPE definition and also fix any other issues.

Looking at the error: "接口 pumpGroup 缺少公开结构体字段声明" - Interface pumpGroup missing public struct field declaration.

Also: "'pumpGroup[tmp_i].RunComd' is no valid assignment target" - This suggests that either ST_Pump isn't properly defined or there's an issue with the inout declaration.

The problem is that ST_Pump needs to be defined as a TYPE before the FUNCTION_BLOCK. Let me add the TYPE definition.

```pascal
TYPE ST_Pump : STRUCT
    priority  : INT;
    selection : BOOL;
    RunComd   : BOOL;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE
```

This needs to come before the FUNCTION_BLOCK.
